plugins.name: fv-analysis
plugins.description: Turn an institute sheet into a decision-grade HTML report, one resumable stage at a time. Stage 1 says what the sheet can and cannot answer before any work is spent; every stage after it pauses for a decision. Includes significance testing, survival with censoring, and two-dimension crossing.

plugins.name: tabular-ml
plugins.description: A change is real only if it survives multiple random validation splits. Multi-seed cross-validation that separates genuine improvements from noise, per-column cleaning rulebooks, leakage and calibration auditing, model comparison ranked by cost as well as score, and tabular foundation models with their context caps and weight licensing enforced.

plugins.name: nerdit_try_plugin
plugins.description: Multi-agent NERDIT LMS course generator. Orchestrates nerdit-lesson-writer and nerdit-qa-validator subagents to turn course-[chaptername]_input.json files into a full course object: course metadata, assessment bank, and per-lesson HTML, duration, and quiz questions.
